entry.title: Surnames of the Balkan Peninsula
entry.subtitle: Regional surname wordcloud maps
entry.excerpt: Surname frequency wordclouds for the Balkan Peninsula and nearby states.
entry.content: Surname frequency wordclouds for the Balkan Peninsula, by administrative unit. Political boundaries are shown according to their “de facto” status. Data came from [Forebears.io](https://forebears.io/). Hub: [Project “Surnames of the World”](/projects/project-surnames-navigator-meta). ## Maps ## FAQ The bigger the word, the more frequent the surname. Wordclouds are built from aggregated surname frequencies by administrative unit. Interactive reference example: Apache ECharts wordcloud demo. ## References - Forebears article (archived): “Accuracy of Surname Statistics on Forebears” - Naming customs: [FamilySearch Europe](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Europe)
